name: web-botanical-dna-mobile-hero-with-glass-orb-and-scientist
title: Phone with thin caps headline and glass sphere plant beside a soft-focus lab technician
whatItIs: A split image: at left a phone with a hazy sunlit grey-green hero, thin uppercase headline, a glass bubble holding leaves and a capsule and a wide white Get Started button; at right a man in a white coat reading a clipboard in a blurred lab.
whatItMeans: Scientific yet natural; the bubble unites lab and garden.
techniques: Pair a mobile hero with a documentary lab photo.
Use a glass orb as a symbolic container.
Set light uppercase across the whole width.

vocabulary.definition: A sphere containing an object that stands for the product.
Beams of light across a backdrop.
UI on one side, photo on the other.
